test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Transparent
solution:
The correct answer is Option (3) i.e., **Opaque.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Transparent: (पारदर्शी) **- Allowing light to pass through so that objects behind can be distinctly seen.

 
 
• **Example**: The water in the lake was so transparent that we could see the fish swimming near the bottom.
